name: AI Lead Capture, Qualification & CRM Routing

parameters.content:
## AI Lead Capture -> Qualification -> CRM Routing

**Flow:** Webhook -> normalize/validate -> Claude qualification (structured) -> hybrid scoring -> tier switch -> HubSpot + Slack / SDR email / nurture / logging.

**Before activating:**
1. Add credentials on the Anthropic, HubSpot, Slack, Gmail and Google Sheets nodes.
2. Replace the placeholder owner emails in **Score & Route** with your real teams.
3. Set the Slack channel, the Google Sheet ID (`YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID`) and the Gmail sender.
4. Point your form at the production webhook: `POST /webhook/lead-capture`.

**Tiers:** hot >= 75, warm >= 50, cold >= 25, below that (or spam >= 0.7) is disqualified.

Thanks for reaching out - I saw your note about {{ $json.ai.useCase || "what you are working on" }}.

- A short overview of how teams like yours get started
- A pricing outline so you know what to expect

If it would be easier to talk it through, reply with a time that suits you and I will send an invite.

Best,
The Sales Team
